sloka: यथा ब्रवीषि हनुमान् सुग्रीव वचनाद् इह ।तत् तथा हि करिष्यावो वचनात् तव सत्तम ॥४-३-३८॥
transliteration: yathā bravīṣi hanumān sugrīva vacanād iha ।tat tathā hi kariṣyāvo vacanāt tava sattama ॥4-3-38॥

translations.english: 'O virtuous Hanuman we will do whatever you are saying, for it is the message of Sugriva.
